description: A utility module for versioned, per-organization salt-based password hashing and verification, supporting multiple algorithms (Argon2id, bcrypt, scrypt) with fallback mechanisms and tenant salt management.

methods.name: getPepper
methods.description: Retrieves the global pepper value from environment variables, defaulting to an empty string if not set.

methods.name: hashPasswordV2
methods.description: Hashes a password using the preferred v2 scheme, selecting the strongest available algorithm (Argon2id, bcrypt, or scrypt fallback).

methods.name: hashPasswordV1
methods.description: Hashes a password using the legacy v1 scheme with static salt and scrypt, used for verifying existing hashes.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies a password against a stored hash, determining the algorithm by hash format and supporting migration from legacy hashes.

methods.name: compareHash
methods.description: Compares a constructed input with a stored hash using the appropriate algorithm (Argon2, bcrypt, or scrypt).

methods.name: ensureTenantOrgSalt
methods.description: Ensures a tenant has an orgSalt; generates and saves one if missing.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Hashes a password with specified version (defaults to v2), using tenant info for v2 or legacy static salt for v1.

methods.name: verifyAndMigrate
methods.description: Verifies a password and provides migration to v2 hash if verification succeeds on legacy v1 hash.
